verification.transport: Injected synthetic provider responses, temporary files and SQLite databases, loopback listeners and a synthetic child worker. No remote request.
verification.independentCodeReview: Read-only audit found no material remaining issue: stopped-app checks run before each reservation, immediately before transport and after responses; failures preserve attempted receipts and stop before the next dispatch. Restart regressions cover zero attempts, one reservation/zero dispatches, and one spent dispatch/no second request. This is detection at boundaries, not exclusive process ownership.

checks: Other processes holding the exact shared budget or review database
Existing ledger reservations, provider leases and review-job gates
Frozen historical receipt and review-state hashes
Only this run reservations and this process provider lease
repeatedBoundaryRepair.inFlightLimitation: An external process can start during a request; observing it at the response boundary stops later dispatches but cannot undo the spent call.

limitations: Qualification is offline and uses injected responses; it does not establish live model quality or Router-enforced decoding.
The prepared diagnostic uses three already-exposed contexts; no fresh quality cohort is selected.
Six attempts and $0.60 planning allowance are the approved scope; execution must bind approval to a frozen manifest and merged unchanged implementation.
An empty-citation insufficient_evidence output is valid but does not exercise citation selection; missing target citations remain inconclusive.
Repeated boundary checks detect observed restarts and history changes; they do not hold exclusive app ownership or undo an in-flight call.
